parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(s.queryid::text,'sin-id') AS query_id,
 s.rows::text AS filas_acumuladas,
 left(s.query,160) AS consulta
FROM public.pg_stat_statements s
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles r ON r.oid = s.userid
WHERE r.rolname = 'agente_ia'
  AND s.query ~* '^[[:space:]]*select[[:space:]]'
  AND (s.query ~* 'from[[:space:]]+(public[.])?clientes\M'
       OR s.query ~* 'from[[:space:]]+(public[.])?ventas\M')
ORDER BY s.rows DESC LIMIT 50;
